study: Training-only future projection repair of the packet JEPA critic
scope: Diagnostic repair on already exposed training and validation; no confirmation or control qualification
motivation: Prior frozen-model audit found varying informative service representations but weak joint future-latent prediction. Separate the auxiliary matching space with an established training-only linear projection.
variant_definition: Shared identity versus learned 48x48 linear projection initialized to identity with zero bias. The original service head consumes the original action latent before projection. Projection is active only for the auxiliary training target or explicit diagnostic evaluation.
training_capacity_caveat: The shared identity has no learnable auxiliary parameters. Any benefit cannot be separated from additional auxiliary training capacity by this two-arm study.
objective: Use the immutable original packet_value.model.objective and update_target, with original masks, regression/NLL/sign costs, auxiliary Smooth L1, context variance regularizer and EMA updates.
paired_initialization: Reset torch and NumPy ordering seed before each variant; all common modules initialize identically and see the same minibatch order. The added projection is exactly identity initially.
selection: Fixed epoch 40 for all six fits. No checkpoint/seed/learning-rate/weight/projection choice from validation. Epoch scores are logged only.
service_metrics: Actual native-label delta-misses MAE/RMSE and gap-seconds MAE/RMSE, overall and separately by handover cost, on training and exposed validation.
future_metrics: MSE and Smooth L1 between projected action latent and same-run EMA future target. Constant denominator is the final training EMA-target mean, scored on validation without recomputing a validation mean. Cross-variant EMA targets differ, so normalize and retain target variance/rank.
collapse_guard: For each paired seed, projected future-target centered RMS and covariance-entropy effective rank must each remain at least 0.8x shared, on BOTH training and validation, before calling a future-matching reduction useful. Also publish context/action/projected/target ranks, variance and trace.
descriptive_gates: Report whether all three seeds improve normalized validation future MSE with the target-collapse guard, and separately whether both validation service MAEs do not increase for every paired seed. These conservative descriptive gates are not statistical confirmation or policy promotion.
frozen_inputs: Record and verify every input against its original native receipt; freeze data and source hashes and a committed preregistration before model optimizer steps.
runtime: Actual CPU PyTorch, one Torch thread; real fixed-data training, no simulated losses or substituted checkpoints.
